A '''ground transport''' was used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]] in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]]. It had a maximum altitude of four meters. [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]], [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]], and [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]] used one to run the [[Gauntlet (Cartann)|gauntlet]] after being [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] from the Adumari nation of [[Cartann]].
